module_summary: 4-bit parallel-to-serial converter: a free-running 2-bit counter reloads a rotating shift register every fourth cycle, emitting its MSB serially with a start pulse.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Rotating shift register loaded from d at cnt==3; MSB drives dout.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Bit counter choosing load versus shift and generating the valid pulse.

anchors.name: valid
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse marking first serial bit of each word; drives valid_out.

groups.name: p2s_shifter
groups.description: Counter-sequenced load/rotate shift register with valid pulse.
